name: in-ference-connections-exporter
description: MV3 Chrome extension — exports a user's own LinkedIn connections to a CSV (name, employer, title, profileUrl) for in-ference contact import. True fork of nanaoosaki/linkedin_connections (MIT). Isolated from the app (own package.json, never bundled by Vite / deployed to Vercel).

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
